Update the Contact page contact information cards so that the Phone card includes "6006422529" and the Email card includes "kfpcsgroup@gmail.com"; ensure both are rendered as clickable tel: / mailto: links where shown.

Add the physical address "Industrial Area IGC Lassipora Pulwama JK 192301" to the site’s visible contact information by updating all places where the address is currently shown in the footer and the Contact page (including the "Visit Us" contact card and the address text shown in the map placeholder section) so the full address is displayed consistently in English.
